content.text: Where does the log in '/home/maxwell-rosen/gkeyll-fork/ci/make-check.sh' get saved to?
I’ll check the script for where it writes its log.

It saves to **`${MODULE}_test.log` in the directory you run the command from**, not necessarily `ci/`.

For example, running `./ci/make-check.sh core` from the repository root saves:
`/home/maxwell-rosen/gkeyll-fork/core_test.log`

The log captures `make`’s stdout and stderr and is overwritten on each run. See [make-check.sh:17](/home/maxwell-rosen/gkeyll-fork/ci/make-check.sh:17).
